text:
zoe: Running the onboarding demo and hit parity issues with the Python SDK. embeddings(single) returns a flat vector but docs + REST return a list-of-lists. rerank async has a different response shape from sync.

zoe: Minimal repro I saw (sync embeddings): { "model": "redwood-embedding-1", "embedding": [0.01, -0.2, 0.3] }

zoe: Expected (REST/docs): { "model": "redwood-embedding-1", "embedding": [[0.01, -0.2, 0.3]] }

olivia: For rerank: async returned: { "ranked": [{ "doc_id": "d1", "score": 0.72 }] } while sync returned: { "scores": [0.72], "doc_ids": ["d1"] }

farid: Sounds like SDK postprocessing collapsed singletons in a previous "convenience" change. Root cause: EmbeddingsClient._postprocess uses collapse_singletons=True; RerankClient._parse uses a different helper.

farid: Proposed immediate fixes: add BatchHelper.normalize_embeddings(input_or_list) to always return List[List[float]]; add RerankNormalizer.normalize_scores() to canonicalize to {"scores": [...], "doc_ids": [...]} ; add tiny compatibility shim that logs a DeprecationWarning if a flat vector is seen.

olivia: Also request stronger typing: add TypedDict/dataclass EmbeddingResponse(vectors: List[List[float]], model: str) and RerankResponse(scores: List[float], doc_ids: List[str]). Current stubs are Any and break mypy.

farid: I'll add unit tests comparing sync vs async for single and batched inputs and a small example in examples/semantic_search that exercises both paths. CI will gate it.

ci-bot: CI queued: tests/embeddings_parity.py on 1720004601.

zoe: Timeline: aim for patch by tomorrow AM. This is blocking several onboarding signups.

olivia: Also flagging that retry middleware had a separate bug where Authorization header could be dropped on retries in async path; adding tests to preserve headers.

farid: Good catch. I'll check retry middleware before merging.

zoe: Thanks — opening a draft PR now with BatchHelper + types + tests, will ping for review.
